notes: **What changed:** Collapse is now global dedup (keep first occurrence) instead of adjacent-only — this fixes `yoyo→yo`, `memo→meo`, `hollo→hol`, `test→tes`, `bobby→boby`. And h-suppression is now simply "collapsed segment starts with 'h'" (all-lower), which correctly suppresses `hobo→hob` (ends b) and `yoyo→yoh`, while keeping `solo→solh`, `polo→polh`, `go→goh`.
